messages:
maria_sec: Quick triage — audit logging coverage gaps across services. I ran a light sweep and the obvious holes are: api-gateway (rate-limited errors not emitted), auth (session revoke events), console (role changes missing attrs), billing (invoice-access events), runtime (model-fallback routing events). Need owners + schema change plan + validation for customer-facing audit events. 30m sync?

ben_infra: I can take api-gateway. :+1: We definitely need to add an "error_type" and "proxy_id" to the gateway events.

samir_runtime: I'll take runtime. Question: do we want KV/cached-context identifiers in runtime events or just request ids? Including KV ids might be sensitive.

maria_sec: Good call. Keep PII out. Use hashed_kv_id if needed. We'll add a field in schema: "reference_hash" instead of raw ids.

julia_prod: For console role changes, product wants to include both pre_change and post_change role blobs for easier customer audit. Any objections? Size concerns?

ben_infra: pre/post blobs could bloat logs. Suggest diffs only + a link to the full snapshot in object-store with proper ACLs.

carol_support: From support perspective, customers frequently ask for who granted a role and why. A small metadata field "grant_reason" would help.

maria_sec: OK: schema update proposal so far: required fields: {"event_type", "actor_id", "resource_id", "timestamp", "outcome"}; optional: {"reference_hash", "diff" OR "snapshot_link", "grant_reason"}.

audit-bot: New schema draft created: /docs/audit/schema/drafts/1855601234-audit-schema-v1.yaml by maria_sec

samir_runtime: KMS integration question: When we sign audit events for integrity, do we use tenant-specific KMS keys or a global signing key per deployment? Tenant keys are ideal for customer validation but increases KMS ops.

maria_sec: Preference is tenant-specific for enterprise/private customers, global signing key for hosted by default. We'll need a migration plan and key-rotation docs. Add to backlog.

julia_prod: Customer-facing validation: we should provide a small validator CLI that verifies signatures and schema and produces a human-readable summary. Could be part of docs/cli.

ben_infra: I'll estimate effort: api-gateway event emission + schema bump = 2 dev days + 1 infra day for storage changes.

samir_runtime: Runtime changes: event hooks in runtime pipeline + masking/hashed refs = 3 dev days.

maria_sec: Prioritization suggestion: P0: auth (session revoke) + console role changes (because customers ask). P1: api-gateway error details + runtime fallback events. Billing event coverage is P2 unless legal says otherwise.

carol_support: Note: a customer asked last week for invoice-access audit log. If legal flags it we'll move billing to P0. Adding ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUPPORT-412

ben_infra: Owner assignments: api-gateway -> ben_infra; auth -> maria_sec; console -> julia_prod; runtime -> samir_runtime; billing -> TBD (maria_sec to follow up with finance/legal).

maria_sec: I'll create the backlog epic and link the schema draft + validator RFC. Action items: 1) owners to sketch event samples (this week) 2) infra to estimate storage/cost impact 3) security to finalize PII rules 4) docs to plan validator CLI.

julia_prod: Happy to draft sample console events.

samir_runtime: Will post runtime event examples by EOD.

ben_infra: I'll open infra estimate PR by tomorrow.

maria_sec: Thanks all. If we need a synchronous call, ping me — otherwise I'll create the epic and assign tasks. :eyes:
